text: **dsh-relink**（DSH 插件，任意支持插件的客户端）：为每个项目保存并检索可复核的工作记忆。它接入 DSH 的输入前处理、会话事件和工具接口，在新请求前召回当前项目的相关记录，并提供记忆搜索、保存、删除和状态查看。还可选用 Markdown 知识库、记录已结束回合，并通过原生子代理并行拆分独立调查、查看任务进度。适合希望跨回合保留项目结论并委派调查的 Harness 用户。默认使用本地 SQLite；不需要 API Key 或外部账号，Markdown 知识库为可选配置。

**dsh-relink** (a DSH plugin): stores project memory locally and recalls relevant records before new requests. Tools search, save, forget, and inspect memory; an optional Markdown vault and native subagents support project work. No API key or external account is required.

**dsh-relink** 的功能「项目记忆自动召回」：新用户输入到达时按当前项目搜索记录，并把最多配置数量的相关内容加入上下文；无匹配或服务异常时会注明状态。
**dsh-relink** 的功能「管理项目记忆」：通过搜索、保存、删除和状态工具管理当前项目记录；保存内容可附证据及项目文件，便于后续确认。
**dsh-relink** 的功能「Markdown 知识库」：配置知识库目录后，可将项目记忆路由到 Markdown 后端，以便用普通编辑器维护；未配置时走 SQLite。
**dsh-relink** 的功能「原生子代理协作」：用 team_start 为最多两个独立调查启动原生子代理，再用 team_wait 等待并查看任务状态。
dsh-relink 可在配置 Markdown 知识库时，将用户请求和最终回复写为未验证的本地任务日志；这不是已核实的项目记忆，且仅在 Markdown 后端启用时写入。

dsh-relink README · English：**dsh-relink** (formerly dsh-memory-team) helps a Harness agent stop rediscovering what it already knows. Before each new request reaches the model, it recalls the few verified findings that matter for the current project, and when nothing relevant exists it says so instead of adding noise. It can split genuinely independent investigations between two native subagents and show where a slow turn spent its time. It never imposes model deadlines, cancels valid work or truncates requested output.

dsh-relink README · English：> [!NOTE]
> This is an unofficial community project and a **prerelease**. Please try it in a separate test profile first. See [Status](#status).

dsh-relink README · Highlights：- **Relevant recall, not noise.** One deterministic relevance model for every backend. Naming a record's key or full title finds it; generic requests such as "please check this file" recall nothing.
- **Local by default.** Memory lives in a local SQLite database with no account, service or extra model call. An optional Markdown vault works with Obsidian and any editor.
- **Nothing runs in the background.** No file watchers, timers or helper processes. Services start on first use, and external edits are picked up on the next read.
- **Honest health reporting.** Every result is `ok`, `no-match`, `degraded`, `withheld` or `unavailable`, so a broken component never looks like an empty memory.
- **Native coordination.** `team_start` uses the host's own `subagent` tool, so permissions, cancellation, recursion limits and result delivery stay under Harness control.
- **Safe upgrades.** 0.5.x databases and notes are read in place, and a round trip with 0.5.3-beta.3 on the same data is tested.

dsh-relink README · Measured in 0.6：Same workloads against 0.5.3-beta.3, five fresh-process runs each, medians. Measured on an Apple M1 with a synthetic labelled corpus; details and trade-offs are in [docs/benchmarks.md](docs/benchmarks.md).

dsh-relink README · Measured in 0.6：| | 0.5.3-beta.3 | 0.6.0-beta.1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unrelated requests that still received recalled records | 40-80% | 0-4% |
| Precision of recalled records | 43-71% | 94-97% |
| First Markdown search over 2,000 existing notes | 861 ms | 312 ms |
| External note edit visible to the next search | 224-330 ms | 107-126 ms |
| Time added to a desktop-runtime cold start | about 100-125 ms | about 50 ms |
| Background helper process with a vault configured | about 190 MiB (Basic Memory) | none |
dsh-relink README · Measured in 0.6：Some searches are 1-2 ms slower than before; [the benchmark notes](docs/benchmarks.md#reading-the-results) explain why.

dsh-relink README · Features：| | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Project memory** | Adds up to three relevant records for the current project before each new user input reaches the model. Records are isolated by project (Git root or working directory). Expired records and records whose evidence files changed are not recalled automatically. |
| **Markdown vault** (optional) | Stores records as plain Markdown that you can edit in Obsidian. The plugin never rewrites your notes on its own, and replacements made through the save tool keep the previous version in history. Add `dsh_private: true` to keep a note out of recall. |
| **Task records** (with a vault) | Records each finished turn as an *unverified* journal note (request, final reply, outcome and tool names) without any model call. Reasoning, tool arguments and tool outputs are not stored. |
| **Subagent coordination** | `team_start` runs up to two independent investigations in parallel; the parent keeps ownership of edits and final acceptance. `team_wait` waits once, without polling. |

dsh-relink README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.3**
- Node.js **22.17 or later** (the Harness desktop app already ships a suitable runtime)
- Optional: Obsidian, [Basic Memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory) 0.23.2 or Betterleaks 1.9.0, all installed separately

dsh-relink README · Installation：1. Download `dsh-relink-0.6.0-beta.2.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/ytsu-ki/dsh-relink/releases) and check it against `SHA256SUMS`.
2. In Harness, open **Plugins > Add plugin** (preferably in a test profile) and enter the absolute path of the downloaded file.
3. Enable **dsh-relink** and restart Harness when prompted.

From the command line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile my-test-profile add /absolute/path/dsh-relink-0.6.0-beta.2.tgz
```

Optional: Markdown vault for Obsidian ```sh node scripts/setup-knowledge.mjs \ --vault '/absolute/path/to/Obsidian Vault/DSH Knowledge' \ --project '/absolute/path/to/project' \ --config-dir '/absolute/path/to/plugin-state'

dsh-relink README · Installation：The script creates the vault and saves the settings to `~/.local/share/dsh-memory-team/settings.json` (this folder keeps the plugin's former name so existing settings still apply), keeping a backup of any previous file. Reload the plugin afterwards. Options: `--seed-file /absolute/notes.json` imports approved `[key, title, kind, summary, evidence]` rows without overwriting existing keys; `--no-activate` prepares files without changing settings.

dsh-relink README · Installation：Keep the `dsh_` frontmatter fields when editing notes in Obsidian. No Obsidian plugin is required.
Optional: Basic Memory

dsh-relink README · Installation：The plugin does not start or require Basic Memory. If you want Basic Memory's own tools on the same vault, install official Basic Memory 0.23.2 separately (on macOS arm64, [`scripts/basic-memory-macos-arm64.txt`](scripts/basic-memory-macos-arm64.txt) pins a verified set of its dependencies for `pip install -r`) and pass `--basic-memory-config /absolute/path` to the setup script. With the settings the script writes, Basic Memory 0.23.2 indexes the plugin's notes without modifying them. Basic Memory 0.24 writes a `permalink` field into notes; the plugin tolerates this, but each rewritten note gets a new revision.
</details>

dsh-relink README · Installation：
Optional: credential scanning with Betterleaks ```sh node scripts/setup-retrieval.mjs ``` Downloads the pinned Betterleaks 1.9.0 release (macOS and Linux, arm64 or x64), verifies its SHA-256 and enables it. `--archive /absolute/release.tar.gz` installs offline. Without Betterleaks, built-in rules still redact common credential formats.

dsh-relink README · Usage：Give Harness a task as usual; the model decides when to search, save or delegate. You can also ask directly:

> Search this project's memory first. Give the implementation investigation and the test review to two independent subagents, fix the problem yourself, then save the verified conclusion.

dsh-relink README · Usage：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `project_memory_search` | Search the current project; an empty query lists recent records |
| `project_memory_save` | Save a verified fact, workflow or pitfall with evidence |
| `project_memory_forget` | Remove a record by key and current revision |
| `project_memory_status` | Show backend, storage paths, health and configuration problems |
| `team_start` | Launch up to two independent investigations |
| `team_wait` | Wait once for native child work, then list task states |
| `workflow_status` | Show steps, output, retries and time breakdown for a turn |

{
  "key": "viewport-acceptance",
  "title": "Prerequisites for 1440px acceptance",
  "kind": "pitfall",

Evidence files are fingerprinted, not copied; if one changes, the record stops being recalled automatically. Replacing a record requires its current `expected_revision`, which a search returns.

dsh-relink README · Configuration：| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/data/dsh-memory-team.sqlite` | SQLite database (absolute path) |
| `knowledgeRoot` | unset | Absolute path of an existing Markdown vault |
| `knowledgeProject` | all projects | Only this project uses the vault; others use SQLite |
| `projectRoot` | automatic | Absolute root that groups itself and its subdirectories |
| `basicMemoryConfig` | `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/data/basic-memory` | State directory for history, trash and the derived index (historical name) |
| `incrementalIndex` | `true` | `false` keeps the derived index in memory only |
| `betterleaksCommand` | unset | Absolute path to Betterleaks 1.9.0 |
| `ttlDays` | `30` | Records older than this (1-365 days) are not recalled automatically |
| `recallLimit` / `recallChars` | `3` / `6000` | Records and characters per automatic recall |
| `maxWorkers` | `2` | Parallel plugin-owned subagents (1-2) |
| `repeatThreshold` / `checkpointSteps` / `longOutputTokens` | `3` / `20` / `4000` | When execution reminders appear |

dsh-relink README · Configuration：`basicMemoryCommand` is still accepted for compatibility and ignored. Storage paths such as the default database file keep the former name `dsh-memory-team` so existing data is found after the rename.

dsh-relink README · Privacy：Everything is stored locally as plaintext. Recalled excerpts are sent to your model provider together with normal requests, so do not save credentials or private conversations. Credentials are screened before anything is saved, recorded or recalled, and a configured scanner that fails blocks memory transfer rather than letting it through. On Windows, files inherit their directory's permissions; see [docs/windows-acceptance.md](docs/windows-acceptance.md).

dsh-relink README · Status：- **Verified:** macOS arm64 with the DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 desktop runtime (installation, tools, saving and recall across process restarts), and the test suite on Node.js 22.17, 24 and 26. See [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md) for details.
- **Not yet verified:** Windows and Linux, and cold starts of the desktop window itself.
- Some 0.5.x users reported that the host failed to start or exited after enabling the plugin. The original cause has not been identified. 0.6 removes the most likely failure points: activation does no filesystem, process or network work, no background process or file watcher runs, and every background error is handled inside the plugin.

dsh-relink README · Status：If Harness fails to start, choose **Disable third-party plugins, back up profile patch, and restart** in the recovery dialog (this affects other third-party plugins too). Please report problems with the [bug report template](https://github.com/ytsu-ki/dsh-relink/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml), including the `crash-...-host.log` from the dialog and the output of `project_memory_status`, with credentials and private data removed.

dsh-relink README · Upgrading from 0.5.x (dsh-memory-team)：0.6 is published under the new name **dsh-relink**. Remove `dsh-memory-team` from the profile first, then install `dsh-relink`. If both stay enabled, whichever loads second fails to activate, so you could keep running the old version without noticing. Your settings, database and Markdown notes are picked up unchanged; no data conversion is needed. If your profile patch overrides the plugin configuration with `id: dsh-memory-team`, change it to `id: dsh-relink`.

dsh-relink README · Upgrading from 0.5.x (dsh-memory-team)：Rolling back means removing `dsh-relink` and reinstalling `dsh-memory-team` 0.5.3-beta.3. The plugin no longer starts Basic Memory, so run it yourself if you use its tools. See [docs/migration.md](docs/migration.md) for the full procedure and the `scripts/migrate.mjs` inspection helper.

dsh-relink README · 简体中文：**鱼的记忆（dsh-relink）**（原名 dsh-memory-team）让 Harness 中的智能体不必反复探索已经知道的事情。每次新请求发送给模型之前，它会为当前项目召回少量真正相关的已验证结论；没有相关内容时，它会如实说明，而不是塞入无关信息。它还可以把真正独立的调查交给两个原生子代理并行处理，并展示一轮缓慢的任务把时间花在了哪里。它从不对模型设置时限、不取消有效工作，也不截断用户要求的输出。

> [!NOTE]
> 这是一个非官方的社区项目，目前为**预发布版**。请先在单独的测试配置（profile）中试用，详见[项目状态](#项目状态)。

dsh-relink README · 亮点：- **召回精准，不制造噪声**：所有存储后端共用同一套确定性的相关度模型。在请求中写出记录的键名或完整标题即可找到它；"请帮我检查这个文件"之类的泛化请求不会召回任何记录。
- **默认完全本地**：记忆保存在本地 SQLite 数据库中，不需要账号、服务或额外的模型调用。可选的 Markdown 知识库可以直接用 Obsidian 或任意编辑器编辑。
- **后台零常驻**：没有文件监听、定时器或辅助进程。服务在首次使用时才启动，外部编辑会在下一次读取时生效。
- **健康状态透明**：每个结果都标明 `ok`、`no-match`、`degraded`、`withheld` 或 `unavailable`，组件故障不会被误认为"没有记忆"。
- **原生协作**：`team_start` 调用宿主自带的 `subagent` 工具，权限、取消、递归层数限制和结果投递都由 Harness 管理。
- **升级安全**：0.5.x 的数据库和笔记原地读取，并且测试过与 0.5.3-beta.3 在同一份数据上来回切换。

dsh-relink README · 0.6 实测数据：在相同负载下与 0.5.3-beta.3 对比，每项在全新进程中重复 5 次，取中位数。测试环境为 Apple M1 和一套带标注的合成语料，方法与取舍详见 [docs/benchmarks.md](docs/benchmarks.md)。

| | 0.5.3-beta.3 | 0.6.0-beta.1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 无关请求仍被注入记录的比例 | 40-80% | 0-4% |
| 召回记录的精确率 | 43-71% | 94-97% |
| 首次检索 2,000 条已有 Markdown 笔记 | 861 ms | 312 ms |
| 外部编辑后，下一次检索可见所需时间 | 224-330 ms | 107-126 ms |
| 桌面运行时冷启动增加的耗时 | 约 100-125 ms | 约 50 ms |
| 配置知识库后的后台辅助进程 | 约 190 MiB（Basic Memory） | 无 |

部分检索比以前慢 1-2 ms，原因见[基准测试说明](docs/benchmarks.md#reading-the-results)。

dsh-relink README · 功能：| | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| **项目记忆** | 每次新的用户输入发送给模型前，为当前项目补充最多三条相关记录。记录按项目隔离（Git 根目录或工作目录）。过期记录、以及证据文件已变化的记录不会被自动召回。 |
| **Markdown 知识库**（可选） | 以纯 Markdown 保存记录，可在 Obsidian 中编辑。插件不会擅自改写你的笔记；通过保存工具替换记录时，旧版本会保留在历史记录中。在笔记中加入 `dsh_private: true` 即可让它不参与召回。 |
| **任务记录**（需配置知识库） | 每轮任务结束后自动记一条*未经验证*的日志笔记（请求、最终回复、结果和工具名称），不调用模型；不保存推理过程、工具参数和工具输出。 |
| **子代理协作** | `team_start` 最多并行运行两个独立调查；修改与最终验收仍由主代理负责。`team_wait` 只等待一次，不轮询。 |
| **执行诊断** | `workflow_status` 报告步数、输出量、重试次数和耗时分解。每轮最多三条简短提醒，提示重复的相同结果或过长的任务；提醒从不阻止工具调用，也不会结束任务。 |

dsh-relink README · 使用：像平常一样给 Harness 布置任务即可，由模型自行决定何时检索、保存或分派任务。你也可以直接要求：

dsh-relink README · 隐私：所有数据都以明文保存在本地。召回的摘录会随正常请求发送给你使用的模型服务商，因此请不要保存凭据或私密对话。保存、记录和召回之前都会筛查凭据；如果已配置的扫描器出现故障，插件会阻止记忆传输，而不是直接放行。在 Windows 上，文件沿用所在目录的权限，详见 [docs/windows-acceptance.md](docs/windows-acceptance.md)。

dsh-relink README · 项目状态：- **已验证**：macOS arm64 上的 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 桌面运行时（安装、工具调用、保存以及跨进程重启后的召回），以及 Node.js 22.17、24 和 26 上的测试套件。详情见 [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md)。
- **尚未验证**：Windows 和 Linux，以及桌面窗口本身的冷启动。
- 部分 0.5.x 用户反馈启用插件后宿主无法启动或意外退出，原始原因至今尚未查明。0.6 消除了最可能的故障点：激活时不进行任何文件、进程或网络操作，不运行后台进程或文件监听，所有后台错误都在插件内部处理。

dsh-relink README · 项目状态：如果 Harness 无法启动，请在恢复对话框中选择 **Disable third-party plugins, back up profile patch, and restart**（这也会影响其他第三方插件）。反馈问题请使用 [Bug 报告模板](https://github.com/ytsu-ki/dsh-relink/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)，附上对话框给出的 `crash-...-host.log` 和 `project_memory_status` 的输出，并删除其中的凭据和隐私信息。

dsh-relink README · 从 0.5.x（dsh-memory-team）升级：0.6 起以新名称 **dsh-relink** 发布。请先从配置中移除 `dsh-memory-team`，再安装 `dsh-relink`。如果两者同时启用，后加载的那个会激活失败，你可能在不知情的情况下继续运行旧版本。已有的设置、数据库和 Markdown 笔记会被原样沿用，无需转换数据。如果你的配置补丁（profile patch）用 `id: dsh-memory-team` 覆盖了插件配置，请改为 `id: dsh-relink`。

回退时，移除 `dsh-relink` 并重新安装 `dsh-memory-team` 0.5.3-beta.3 即可。新版插件不再启动 Basic Memory，如果你需要使用它的工具，请自行运行。完整步骤和检查工具 `scripts/migrate.mjs` 见 [docs/migration.md](docs/migration.md)。
